page_title: The Fast Remote Desktop Application – AnyDesk

sources.entry: AnyDesk - Provides remote access across multiple machines.

summary.name: AnyDesk
summary.one_liner: AnyDesk is a remote desktop application for accessing, controlling, and supporting computers and devices from another location.
use_cases: Accessing a work computer from another location
Guiding customers through issues in help desk sessions
Team collaboration on a shared screen
Hosting remote access on your own servers
Controlling desktops from a phone or tablet
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AnyDesk as remote access software organized around four areas: collaboration (shared views, chat, on-screen highlighting, session recording), assistance (connecting to and guiding users with responsive controls), access (opening files, launching apps, and continuing tasks across platforms), and security (encryption, permission control, SSO and 2FA, and choice of cloud or on-premises deployment). Version 9 is mentioned with features for help desk and customer care teams, including session requests, session invitation links, and session queues. It can run in the cloud or on the user's own servers. The page also states that mobile devices can access and control desktops, servers, and other devices, and that the product can be customized and branded for users.
notable: Cloud or on-premises deployment, with on-premises installs on your own servers
Help desk features: session requests, invitation links, and queues in Version 9
Customizable, brandable version of the client for an organization's users
Mobile control of desktops and servers from smartphones and tablets
caveats: Page references a License Configurator and plan selection, implying paid plans exist, but prices are not shown on the page
Platform list is not fully stated on the page; Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and web are inferred only from general mobile and cross-platform mentions, so treat as unverified
